episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.summary: Cate travels to Japan to get answers about her father and uncovers a shocking secret. Keiko, Lee, and Billy pursue a theory about Titans.

episodes.title: Departure
episodes.summary: Monarch closes in on Cate, Kentaro, and May as they try to track down a key individual. Keiko, Lee, and Billy stumble on a major find.

episodes.title: Secrets and Lies
episodes.summary: Shaw leads the team on a dangerous mission to Alaska in search of Hiroshi. Keiko, Lee, and Billy present their findings to General Puckett.

episodes.title: Parallels and Interiors
episodes.summary: The team is left stranded in the frozen tundra after a narrow escape. Kentaro reflects on his relationships.

episodes.title: The Way Out
episodes.summary: Cate's painful memories of G-Day come flooding back as she treks through the ruins of San Francisco with Kentaro and May.

episodes.title: Terrifying Miracles
episodes.summary: Shaw finds an unlikely ally within Monarch as the team has a harrowing run-in. Keiko and Lee grow closer while at a military ball.

episodes.title: Will the Real May Please Stand Up?
episodes.summary: May finally faces her past. Duvall and Shaw follow traces of Godzilla and Hiroshi.

episodes.title: Birthright
episodes.summary: The team goes back to where things all began to confront Shaw. On the brink of collapse, Monarch takes drastic measures.

episodes.title: Axis Mundi
episodes.summary: Shaw and May search for Cate and make a startling discovery. Kentaro struggles with his loss.

episodes.title: Beyond Logic
episodes.summary: Season finale. The team struggles to find a way out of Axis Mundi. Kentaro and Tim make an unexpected alliance.

episodes.title: Cause and Effect
episodes.summary: Decades after being presumed dead, Keiko's return shocks Monarch. Cate defies orders to save Shaw—and unleashes a terrifying new Titan.

episodes.title: Resonance
episodes.summary: Lee and Keiko investigate a secretive village with a cult devoted to a mysterious creature. Cate crosses paths with a deadly stowaway.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.summary: Shaw, Keiko, Hiroshi, and Kentaro go rogue in an attempt to find Titan X. Cate struggles with feelings of guilt. A buried secret is exposed.

episodes.title: Trespass
episodes.summary: To get Hiroshi's device back, Shaw and the team execute a daring heist at Apex Cybernetics.

episodes.title: Furusato
episodes.summary: In Santa Soledad, Titan X becomes a target for Apex, forcing Shaw and the Randas to infiltrate the covert experiment.

episodes.title: Requiem
episodes.summary: Shaw and Suzuki test a "Titan phone" designed to summon Godzilla, triggering an unforeseen event that puts Shaw in the path of his own past.

episodes.title: String Theory
episodes.summary: Shaw receives an impossible radio transmission. Cate and Keiko uncover an ancient link to Titan X. Isabel has a proposition for Kentaro.

episodes.title: Separate Ways
episodes.summary: Titan X makes landfall in Australia, where Shaw lures Godzilla into a showdown. Isabel uses the battle as a distraction for her secret operation.

episodes.title: Ends of the Earth
episodes.summary: Monarch and the team head to Skull Island. Cate tries to reason with Kentaro and stop Isabel. Shaw and Keiko search for Billy's long-lost rift.

episodes.title: Where We Belong
episodes.summary: Season finale. Kong and Titan X face off in a colossal clash that threatens to reshape Skull Island. Shaw embarks on a dangerous journey.
